brief: We built the same product twice. The second version made 10x more. Here's why.

slots.stickyNote: here's exactly what I did (and broke)
slots.intro: The second version made 10x more revenue with half the features.

slots.title: We chased
slots.subtitle: Twelve months of silent building before a single customer saw the login screen.
slots.insight1Body: Custom dashboards, AI tagging, and a chrome extension no one downloaded.
slots.insight2Title: Launch day felt like a funeral
slots.insight2Body: Three signups. Two were my mom and my cofounder.
slots.insight3Body: We confused motion with momentum for an entire year.
slots.authorQuote: I thought polish would sell itself. I was wrong.

slots.title: Sales come
slots.subtitle: Customers don't buy roadmaps. They buy relief from pain, delivered yesterday.
slots.insight1Title: The best product is the one that ships
slots.insight1Body: Every week in stealth is a week without feedback loops.
slots.insight2Body: We rewrote the onboarding five times after one Zoom call.
slots.insight3Body: A mediocre product with great reach outperforms a hidden masterpiece.
slots.authorQuote: I stopped building for myself and started building for strangers with credit cards.

slots.title: We cut
slots.subtitle: One core workflow, one page, and a Stripe link. That was the entire MVP.
slots.insight1Body: If the landing page needs more than two sentences, the idea is too complex.
slots.insight2Title: No code until the contract is signed
slots.insight2Body: We pre-sold the second version using Figma prototypes and a waitlist.
slots.insight3Body: Daily tweets turned lurkers into beta testers before we had a database.
slots.authorQuote: The second time, we sold the promise before we wrote the first line of code.

slots.title: Launch loud
slots.subtitle: We posted demos, sent cold DMs, and made the product impossible to ignore.
slots.insight1Body: We found them in comment sections, not Google Ads.
slots.insight2Body: A two-minute Loom drove more conversions than our entire help center.
slots.insight3Body: Fifty lifetime deals sold out in six hours, funding the next month.
slots.authorQuote: We traded our pride for presence everywhere our customers already lived.

slots.title: Ten times
slots.subtitle: The stripped-down version out-earned the bloated one before we even added integrations.
slots.insight1Body: Our runway went from six months to profitable in ninety days.
slots.insight2Body: Every feature we added next was directly funded by user requests.
slots.insight3Body: While competitors plan, we ship, learn, and iterate in public.
slots.authorQuote: The product that took two weeks made more than the year-long masterpiece.

slots.title: Ship fast
slots.subtitle: This is the only framework you need to escape the rebuild trap forever.
slots.insight1Body: Complexity is a tax on your runway and your customer's patience.
slots.insight2Title: Charge before you build the second half
slots.insight2Body: Revenue is the only validation that matters for a new idea.
slots.insight3Body: A waitlist with five hundred people is worth more than perfect auth.
slots.authorQuote: My next idea didn't need more time. It needed more courage to launch ugly.

slots.ctaBody: I write about shipping fast and breaking things gently. Follow along if you're building in public too.
